title: FPS Flood: Create
description: FPS Flood: Create is a lightweight, high‑performance modpack that delivers smooth FPS and stable Create automation on NeoForge 1.21.1 — even on older hardware
body:
# FPS Flood: Create – by Pixelforge Collective

⚠️ This is a official version of [FPS Flood; Pixelforge Collective](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fps-flood-pixelforge-collective)

⚠️ Do NOT add Iris to v1.0.1 or v1.1.1 — it WILL break your game.


FPS Flood: Create is a performance‑enhanced Minecraft modpack built for players who want the smooth, optimized experience of FPS Flood — combined with the engineering power of the Create mod and its essential add‑ons.


FPS Flood: Create stays true to what makes the pack great — it’s clean, fast, responsive, and lightweight — while adding a fully tuned Create setup built for smooth automation, big factories, and complex contraptions, even on older PCs.


The modpack includes a carefully tested selection of performance mods, Create expansions, UI improvements, and additional settings that make mechanical builds feel smoother, more stable, and more enjoyable.


Features
Performance‑optimized Create gameplay

* Stable automation even with large factories and moving contraptions

* Essential Create add‑ons that expand mechanical possibilities without adding bloat

* Better FPS and responsiveness during heavy processing

* Enhanced UI and menu improvements

* Additional graphics and gameplay settings

* Lightweight, clean, and smooth gameplay experience

* Carefully tested mod selection for NeoForge 1.21.1


FPS Flood: Create keeps the core Create experience intact while refining it with modern enhancements, stability improvements, and performance‑focused optimizations.


Notes
1. This version is not designed for shader optimization. Heavy shaders may still significantly impact FPS depending on your hardware.

2. Recommended: 6GB allocated

3. Tested on older hardware and DDR3L RAM

4. For best results, set your resolution to what your GPU is designed for.
